## The Marketing Hiring Challenge

Marketing campaigns have deadlines that don't wait for recruiting. Product launches, seasonal pushes, and brand initiatives need talent now—not in 3 months.

The marketing landscape evolves constantly. Today's channels (TikTok, AI tools, new ad platforms) require specialized skills that generalist marketers may lack.

Creative work is subjective and hard to evaluate. Portfolios can be misleading—you need verification that candidates actually did the work they claim.

### The TaaSFlow Solution

- Portfolio verification: we confirm candidates actually created their claimed work
- Performance marketers with verified ROAS and conversion metrics
- Content creators across video, written, social, and podcast formats
- Brand strategists with Fortune 500 and startup experience
- Campaign surge capacity: scale up for launches, scale back after
